# NO VENDOR SUBSCRIBE — BGOP Engage

**Binding for this app.**

We **clone** engagement-platform capabilities.  
We **do not** subscribe to Iterable, Braze, Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar as the product backbone.

| Allowed | Forbidden |
|---|---|
| Native `engage.*` schema + modules | `ITERABLE_API_KEY` / `api.iterable.com` product wire |
| E30 SendGrid/SES as **our** email gun | Treating Iterable as SoR or required SaaS |
| Reading Iterable teardown docs as competitive research | Shipping brand SDKs Ed must pay for to operate Engage |
| Naming our product **BGOP Engage** | Naming modules/APIs after Iterable product surfaces as if we rent them |

If a PR reintroduces a paid-brand ESP as required runtime, **reject it**.
